verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a commerce/payments platform, but the evidence shows the core product (agent token provisioning, purchase-intent mandates, credential retrieval, VisaNet authorization controls) is only reachable as Visa-hosted, credential-gated APIs, with sandbox sign-up and production fees set by contacting Visa. The open-source Trusted Agent Protocol reference implementation and the locally runnable MCP/agent toolkit are adjacent pieces or clients of the hosted APIs, not a self-hostable deployment of the core product, so they earn no credit.
